entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Why are people doubting the[n]Phantom Thieves over what[n]happened to President Okumura?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: They'd never do such a thing!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...Is that supposed to[n]be some kind of joke?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are the allies[n]of justice. There's no way they'd[n]ever do something so horrible.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Because I'm a sympathetic[n]supporter of theirs.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I've already made up my mind...[n]No matter what happens, I'm[n]going to support them.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Anyway, it seems like everyone's[n]forgotten all that they've done[n]up to this point.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: That won't stop me though.[n]I'll continue cheering them on.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Make sure you tell them[n]that! Well, see you later!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Mishima is a bit narrow-sighted, but he's[n]a good person deep down. We can't[n]betray him...
